instruction: A candid outdoor full shot from a low angle shows a young couple walking on a sunny day. On the left, the woman in the white long-sleeved dress (R1) walks forward wearing white boots, smiling. On the right, the man in the patterned short-sleeved shirt (R2) walks alongside her in khaki trousers and black shoes. They hold hands as they walk next to a black ornate metal fence on a stone wall. Bright daylight casts soft shadows on the scene.
